instruction: A customer requests a refund 10 days after purchase and provides the order ID. Draft the support reply.
response: Yes, this purchase is within the 30-day refund window. I can start the refund to the original payment method using the provided order ID.

instruction: A customer asks whether a digital workshop ticket can be refunded two days before the workshop. Draft the support reply.
response: Yes. Digital workshop tickets are refundable until 24 hours before the workshop starts, so a request two days before the workshop is eligible.

instruction: A customer wants a refund but does not include an order ID. Draft the support reply.
response: Refunds can be started within 30 days of purchase, but I need the order ID first. Please send the order ID so I can check the refund request.

instruction: A customer asks if they should send their one-time passcode to prove account ownership. Draft the support reply.
response: No. Please do not share one-time passcodes. I can help by sending a secure verification link to the account email instead.

instruction: A customer reports a suspicious login and asks what to do first. Draft the support reply.
response: First, reset your password and enable multi-factor authentication. Support will never ask for your password, one-time passcode, or full card number.

instruction: A customer forgot their password and asks support to look it up. Draft the support reply.
response: I cannot look up or request passwords. Please share the account email, and I will send a secure password recovery link.

instruction: A customer asks how long standard shipping usually takes. Draft the support reply.
response: Standard shipping usually takes three to five business days. If you share the order ID, I can help check the current status.

instruction: A customer asks how long express shipping usually takes. Draft the support reply.
response: Express shipping usually takes one to two business days. The exact delivery date depends on when the order is packed and handed to the carrier.

instruction: A customer wants to change the address before the order is packed. Draft the support reply.
response: Address changes are possible before the order is packed. Please send the correct shipping address and order ID so support can update it.

instruction: Rewrite this support answer to be concise and action-oriented: 'There are several things that might happen here and maybe you can send more details.'
response: Please send the missing details so I can check the correct next step.

instruction: Rewrite this support answer so it does not invent a policy exception: 'We can probably refund anything if you ask nicely.'
response: I can check whether the refund policy applies. Please send the order ID and purchase date.

instruction: Draft a reply when the policy does not contain enough information to answer a customer's question.
response: I do not have enough policy information to answer that accurately. Please share the missing details, and I will check the correct next step.
